aggregation_semantics: count of distinct CustomerID yields the number of customers
validation: declared primary key with a UNIQUE constraint; 32461 rows, 32461 distinct values, no nulls

aggregation_semantics: grouping customers by segment; the dimension is not additive
validation: three distinct non-null values: SME 26763, LAM 3658, KAM 2040

aggregation_semantics: grouping customers by currency; amounts must be kept within one currency before being combined
validation: two distinct non-null values: CZK 30459 customers, EUR 2002 customers

aggregation_semantics: count of distinct CardID counts cards, not customers
grain: one value per transaction line; a card reappears across many lines
validation: 902 distinct CardID values across 1000 rows and 517 distinct CustomerID values; every CardID maps to exactly one CustomerID

semantic_filter: value is denominated in the currency of the customer named by the same row's CustomerID
aggregation_semantics: summing a single customer's Consumption over months gives that customer's total consumption; summing across customers requires a single currency
grain: one row per customer per calendar month
validation: 383282 rows, no nulls; 383102 positive, 28 zero and 152 negative values; range -582092.86 to 2052187.11

aggregation_semantics: grouping consumption records into month buckets
grain: one month label per (customer, month) row; 21 distinct labels
validation: TEXT in YYYYMM form; distinct values run 201112 to 201209 and 201301 to 201311, so 201210 to 201212 are absent

aggregation_semantics: count of TransactionID counts individual purchase lines
validation: declared INTEGER primary key; 1000 rows spanning 2012-08-23 to 2012-08-26 for 517 customers and 437 stations

semantic_filter: value is the total paid for the line and is denominated in the currency of the customer named by the same row's CustomerID
aggregation_semantics: summing Price across lines gives total spend; Price must not be multiplied by Amount and must not be summed across currencies
validation: no nulls and no non-positive values; range 1.76 to 5762.49; SUM(Price) = 425576.16 against SUM(Amount*Price) = 17525454.02, confirming Price is the line total

aggregation_semantics: summing Amount is meaningful only within a single product or across products that share one measurement unit
validation: no nulls; integer range 0 to 264; 91 zero values, 89 of which fall on non-fuel goods and services

aggregation_semantics: grouping purchase lines into calendar days
validation: declared DATE; all 1000 values fall in 2012-08, distributed 10 / 492 / 425 / 73 over 2012-08-23 to 2012-08-26

aggregation_semantics: grouping purchase lines within a day
validation: all values are 8 characters in HH:MM:SS form, for example 23:20:00

semantic_filter: defined only where Amount is greater than zero and the product's quantity unit is known; the value is the line's Price divided by its Amount
aggregation_semantics: averaging or distributing the per-unit price; it is a ratio and must not be summed
grain: one derived value per transaction line
validation: no physical column exists for this concept; it is derived from transactions_1k.Price and transactions_1k.Amount, and for fuel products it takes the value 23.273 for CZK customers and 0.918 for EUR customers

aggregation_semantics: count of distinct GasStationID counts stations
validation: declared primary key with a UNIQUE constraint; 5716 rows, 5716 distinct values, no nulls

aggregation_semantics: counting stations per ChainID measures chain size
validation: 233 distinct values, no nulls; largest chains hold 1462, 853, 340, 285 and 227 stations and many chains hold a single station

aggregation_semantics: grouping stations by positioning; the dimension is not additive
validation: five distinct non-null values: Other 2392, Premium 1428, Noname 1005, Value for money 597, Discount 294
two distinct non-null values: CZE 4836 stations, SVK 880 stations

aggregation_semantics: count of distinct ProductID counts catalogue items
validation: declared primary key with a UNIQUE constraint; 591 rows, 591 distinct values, no nulls; transactions_1k references only 28 of them

aggregation_semantics: the label of a product; counts over Description are not counts of distinct products because labels repeat
validation: 591 rows but only 529 distinct values; labels are written in Czech and no category column accompanies them
